d: Operate and support the Ministry's server, virtualisation, storage, and core infrastructure platforms through local onsite coordination and secured remote offshore monitoring.
q: 6+ years of relevant infrastructure and server administration experience.
Strong hands-on experience with Windows Server and/or enterprise Linux, Active Directory, and virtualisation technologies.
Practical knowledge of monitoring, patch management, storage, capacity planning, and security hardening.
VCP, MCSE, RHCSA, or Server+ preferred.
r: Administer Windows/Linux server environments, virtualisation, storage, and infrastructure services.
Monitor availability, capacity, and performance; investigate alerts and restore service.
Plan and execute approved patching, configuration changes, hardening, and lifecycle maintenance.
Maintain server inventories, configuration records, operating procedures, and runbooks.
Support incident, problem, and change management including root-cause analysis.
Coordinate infrastructure dependencies with network, cloud, backup, cybersecurity, application, and database teams.
Participate in agreed on-call coverage for critical infrastructure incidents.
